risks.note: Increasing consumer preference for on-demand and OTT-based content continues to impact traditional linear television viewership, the core of the cable distribution business
risks.risk: Structural shift in content consumption towards OTT and on-demand platforms

risks.note: Intense competition brings customer churn from set-top box replacements by other MSOs, downward pressure on ARPU and difficulty expanding into new markets; mitigated by LCO/distributor engagement, the LCO Lighthouse App and competitive pricing
risks.risk: Market share loss and subscriber churn to competing MSOs, DTH and digital-first platforms

risks.note: Price sensitivity in mass markets combined with regulatory constraints continues to limit meaningful improvement in average revenue per user
The business model relies significantly on local cable operators for last-mile delivery, posing challenges in standardisation of service quality and revenue assurance
risks.risk: Dependence on the local cable operator (LCO) network

risks.note: The pace of change in digital content delivery, STB capabilities and the rollout of high-speed networks such as 5G compels continuous upgrade of the technology ecosystem; mitigated by MPEG-4 migration, HD/MPEG-4-only STBs and higher channel capacity at key head-ends

New directives on channel pricing, bundling, tariff orders or net neutrality, and any change in FDI policy or sector-specific taxation, could impact business models, cost structures and customer offerings
risks.risk: Regulatory and policy risk from TRAI, DoT and the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting

risks.note: Expanding digital infrastructure and remote operations increase exposure to cyber threats affecting confidentiality, availability and integrity of information systems; mitigated by secure VPN access, 24/7 monitoring of critical systems and periodic staff sensitisation

Inflationary trends and rising energy costs can indirectly impact consumer spending and operational expenses; MD&A also flags elevated costs in content production and distribution alongside cautious advertising spend as a near-term drag on industry growth
